options.name: accessPolicyNumber
options.description: The number of a custom access policy to configure on the switch port. Only applicable when 'accessPolicyType' is 'Custom access policy'.

options.name: accessPolicyType
options.description: The type of the access policy of the switch port. Only applicable to access ports. Can be one of 'Open', 'Custom access policy', 'MAC allow list' or 'Sticky MAC allow list'.

options.name: adaptivePolicyGroupId
options.description: The adaptive policy group ID that will be used to tag traffic through this switch port. This ID must pre-exist during the configuration, else needs to be created using adaptivePolicy/groups API. Cannot be applied to a port on a switch bound to profile.

options.name: allowedVlans
options.description: The VLANs allowed on the switch port. Only applicable to trunk ports.

options.name: daiTrusted
options.description: If true, ARP packets for this port will be considered trusted, and Dynamic ARP Inspection will allow the traffic.

options.name: dot3az
options.description: Dot3az settings for the port.

options.name: enabled
options.description: The status of the switch port.

options.name: flexibleStackingEnabled
options.description: For supported switches (e.g. MS420/MS425), whether or not the port has flexible stacking enabled.

options.name: highSpeed
options.description: High speed port enablement settings for C9500-32QC.

options.name: isolationEnabled
options.description: The isolation status of the switch port.

options.name: linkNegotiation
options.description: The link speed for the switch port.

options.name: macAllowList
options.description: Only devices with MAC addresses specified in this list will have access to this port. Up to 20 MAC addresses can be defined. Only applicable when 'accessPolicyType' is 'MAC allow list'.

options.name: macWhitelistLimit
options.description: The maximum number of MAC addresses for regular MAC allow list. Only applicable when 'accessPolicyType' is 'MAC allow list'. Note Config only supported on verions greater than ms18 only for classic switches.

options.name: meraki_action_batch_retry_wait_time
options.displayName: Meraki Action Batch Retry Wait Time
options.description: meraki_action_batch_retry_wait_time (integer), action batch concurrency error retry wait time

options.name: meraki_api_key
options.description: meraki_api_key (string), API key generated in dashboard; can also be set as an environment variable MERAKI_DASHBOARD_API_KEY

options.name: meraki_base_url
options.description: meraki_base_url (string), preceding all endpoint resources

options.name: meraki_be_geo_id
options.description: meraki_be_geo_id (string), optional partner identifier for API usage tracking; can also be set as an environment variable BE_GEO_ID

options.name: meraki_certificate_path
options.description: meraki_certificate_path (string), path for TLS/SSL certificate verification if behind local proxy

options.name: meraki_inherit_logging_config
options.description: meraki_inherit_logging_config (boolean), Inherits your own logger instance

options.name: meraki_log_file_prefix
options.description: meraki_log_file_prefix (string), log file name appended with date and timestamp

options.name: meraki_log_path
options.description: log_path (string), path to output log; by default, working directory of script if not specified

options.name: meraki_maximum_retries
options.description: meraki_maximum_retries (integer), retry up to this many times when encountering 429s or other server-side errors

options.name: meraki_nginx_429_retry_wait_time
options.description: meraki_nginx_429_retry_wait_time (integer), Nginx 429 retry wait time

options.name: meraki_output_log
options.description: meraki_output_log (boolean), create an output log file?

options.name: meraki_print_console
options.description: meraki_print_console (boolean), print logging output to console?

options.name: meraki_requests_proxy
options.description: meraki_requests_proxy (string), proxy server and port, if needed, for HTTPS

options.name: meraki_retry_4xx_error
options.description: meraki_retry_4xx_error (boolean), retry if encountering other 4XX error (besides 429)?

options.name: meraki_retry_4xx_error_wait_time
options.description: meraki_retry_4xx_error_wait_time (integer), other 4XX error retry wait time

options.name: meraki_simulate
options.description: meraki_simulate (boolean), simulate POST/PUT/DELETE calls to prevent changes?

options.name: meraki_single_request_timeout
options.description: meraki_single_request_timeout (integer), maximum number of seconds for each API call

options.name: meraki_suppress_logging
options.description: meraki_suppress_logging (boolean), disable all logging? you're on your own then!

options.name: meraki_use_iterator_for_get_pages
options.displayName: Meraki Use Iterator For Get Pages
options.description: meraki_use_iterator_for_get_pages (boolean), list* methods will return an iterator with each object instead of a complete list with all items

options.name: meraki_wait_on_rate_limit
options.description: meraki_wait_on_rate_limit (boolean), retry if 429 rate limit error encountered?

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the switch port.

options.name: peerSgtCapable
options.description: If true, Peer SGT is enabled for traffic through this switch port. Applicable to trunk port only, not access port. Cannot be applied to a port on a switch bound to profile.

options.name: poeEnabled
options.description: The PoE status of the switch port.

options.name: portId
options.description: PortId path parameter. Port ID.

options.name: portScheduleId
options.description: The ID of the port schedule. A value of null will clear the port schedule.

options.name: profile
options.description: Profile attributes.

options.name: rstpEnabled
options.description: The rapid spanning tree protocol status.

options.name: serial
options.description: Serial path parameter.

options.name: stickyMacAllowList
options.description: The initial list of MAC addresses for sticky Mac allow list. Only applicable when 'accessPolicyType' is 'Sticky MAC allow list'.

options.name: stickyMacAllowListLimit
options.description: The maximum number of MAC addresses for sticky MAC allow list. Only applicable when 'accessPolicyType' is 'Sticky MAC allow list'.

options.name: stormControlEnabled
options.description: The storm control status of the switch port.

options.name: stpGuard
options.description: The state of the STP guard ('disabled', 'root guard', 'bpdu guard' or 'loop guard').

options.name: stpPortFastTrunk
options.description: The state of STP PortFast Trunk on the switch port.

options.name: tags
options.description: The list of tags of the switch port.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of the switch port ('access', 'trunk', 'stack', 'routed', 'svl' or 'dad').

options.name: udld
options.description: The action to take when Unidirectional Link is detected (Alert only, Enforce). Default configuration is Alert only.

options.name: vlan
options.description: The VLAN of the switch port. For a trunk port, this is the native VLAN. A null value will clear the value set for trunk ports.

options.name: voiceVlan
options.description: The voice VLAN of the switch port. Only applicable to access ports.
